title: Great Gift!
text: Great Gift!. This mug was a big hit at Christmas! It came beautifully packaged in it's own little wooden crate and is really lovely! Along with all the Moscow Mule fixin's it is the perfect gift!

product_metadata.title: [GIFT SET] Advanced Mixology Moscow Mule Pure Copper Mug with Artisan Hand Crafted Wooden Box and Coaster Gift Set
features: CLASSY GIFT BOX - Our Copper Moscow Mule Mugs are a top pick for "Gifts for Men"
PURE COPPER - No nickel, tin, or other metals on copper mugs! Only pure copper to give your moscow mule the right taste.
PERFECT SIZE - 16 oz. size just like the original copper moscow mule mug. Not too large nor too small
LATEST TECHNOLOGY, NO RIVETS - Rivets basically need holes to screw on the handles, so they leak after a while. Advanced Mixology uses the latest metal joining technology to get a no rivet joint
TARNISH RESISTANT - Coated with food grade lacquer to retain its shine. Just scrub the coating away if you like the antique look
